services.name: Capitol Square Downtown Tour
services.desc: Discover Madison’s Hidden Culinary Gems Rates Adult: $89 Duration 3 Hours About Sample classic Wisconsin fare as we tour downtown Madison’s Capitol Square and neighboring areas–a great way to experience “real Wisconsin” flavors while discovering hidden gems! Enjoy five stops with generous “samples”. WEEKDAY includes tacos, agua fresca and cheese tasting and an old fashioned. WEEKEND includes pretzel and beer sample, cheese curds and wings. Both tours include pizza by the slice, pasties and a tour of the Capitol. We’ll end the tour with real Wisconsin ice cream for dessert, and plenty of fun, local trivia. services.name: Atwood Brew & Chew
services.desc: Discover Madison’s Hidden Culinary Gems Rates Adult (Ages 21+): $99 Duration 3 Hours About Enjoy a culinary tour of Madison’s hip east side neighborhood including tastings at 5 locations with two drink samples, PLUS a bonus shopping stop at an artisan chocolate shop (special discount for our tour groups!)! This historic neighborhood boasts a native sandstone mansion that was home to Dane County’s first state senator, as well as historic churches, bars, an old movie theater, and of course incredible restaurants and micro breweries. services.name: Willy Street Global Eats Food Tour
services.desc: Discover Madison’s Hidden Culinary Gems Rates All ages, about a 2 miles route, 3 alcoholic drinks included Duration 3-3.5 Hours About Explore one of Madison’s most culturally diverse culinary neighborhoods. Enjoy generous tastings at 5 stops including Indonesian, Latin, East African and Pakistani cuisine, plus craft cocktails and dessert. Discover Madison’s first city park, and the unique architecture of this eclectic and vibrant neighborhood. Tour includes 3 cocktail (or cocktail) samples and 5 seated stops! Learn and taste firsthand about the unique backgrounds of our chefs and growers that drive Madison’s burgeoning food scene. PLEASE NOTE the start and end of the tour are about 1 mile

services.name: Bike n Bites Tour
services.desc: Explore the tastes and sights of Madison's beautiful and bikeable east side neighborhoods! Rates Person: $129 All individuals must be 18 years or older to participate. Duration 3 Hours About Explore the tastes and sights of Madison’s beautiful and bikeable east-side neighborhoods! Join us on a BCycle as we explore the Willy Street, Atwood, and Olbrich neighborhoods. Enjoy 7 food tastings and 2 drink samples! We’ll start at the historic Garver Feed Mill where we’ll get an overview of the tour, and learn the basics of riding the BCycles. services.name: Holiday Cocktail & Food Tour
services.desc: Includes: 5 stops; delicious food tastings; 3 boozy craft cocktails (or mocktails); boozy dessert (non-booze options); Capitol Holiday treeLocations subject to change. Details Enjoy the festive holiday season in Madison WI on our Holiday Cocktail & Food Tour in Downtown Madison, WI. This tour features boozy drinks and delicious bites at three of our very favorite downtown restaurants, includes a sweet treat and enough food for a light meal! NON-ALCOHOLIC OPTIONS available. We CANNOT guarantee dietary restrictions or specific locations. The festivities begin at a local farm to table restaurant where we’ll enjoy a delicious seasonal cocktail and a “chef’s selection” of 2 signature dishes.

services.name: Madison Eats Food Tours and Camp Trippalindee present: Cheese Camp
services.desc: Pack your bags . Madison Eats and Camp Trippalindee are teaming up to bring you Cheese Camp, a one-night only summer adventure celebrating Wisconsin’s best cheeses. Indulge in a cheese tasting experience featuring Landmark Creamery, hear from experts about production and pairings, and get a lesson on how to craft the ultimate cheese board – plus you get a board to keep! Counselors from Madison Eats, Camp Trippalindee, and Landmark Creamery will provide you with cheese knowledge and camp memories to last long after the summer suns fades. All campers will receive drink pairings, a cheese flight, a keepsake cheeseboard and a postcard to write home to mom about what you learned.
